text:
Predicates:
FavoriteSeason(x, y) ::: x's favorite season is y.
LongVacation(x) ::: x wants to have a long vacation.
LoveSeason(x, y) ::: x loves season y.
Season(y) ::: y is a season.
Student(x) ::: x is a student.
WantsLongVacation(x) ::: x wants to have a long vacation.
Emma ::: Emma.
Mia ::: Mia.
James ::: James.
Summer ::: summer.

Premises:
Season(spring) ∧ Season(summer) ∧ Season(fall) ∧ Season(winter) ::: There are four seasons: Spring, Summer, Fall, and Winter.
∀x (Student(x) → LoveSeason(x, summer)) ::: All students who want a long vacation love summer the most.
FavoriteSeason(Emma, summer) ::: Emma's favorite season is summer.
FavoriteSeason(Mia, y) ∧ FavoriteSeason(Emma, summer) → y ≠ summer ::: Mia's favorite season is not summer, different from Emma's.
WantsLongVacation(James) ::: James wants to have a long vacation.

Conclusion:
FavoriteSeason(James, summer) ::: James's favorite season is summer.
